title: atm task hooks, hook registration, atm cron, doctor hook section
description:
## Goal
Every `atm task` subcommand can be filtered by hooks registered per team and phase; for a command the daemon runs the active phases' modules oldest first, each with one JSON request in a fixed environment under its `TIMEOUT_MS`, until one replies other than not-applicable (handled: run these atm actions un-hooked; pass-through: run the normal command; refused: fail with the message). `atm cron start|end|list` keeps schedules in the daemon store and the `atm-cron` worker ticks them through the same contract. `atm doctor` calls each active module's `doctor()` for the caller's team. Authority: `docs/plans/phase-bk/design.md` over Rand's verbatim rulings on atm-core #1873 (2026-10-18); anchors `docs/plans/phase-bk/anchors.md`; requirements `docs/requirements.md` §11.5, §23, §24; ADR-068, ADR-069, ADR-061 D6 record of 2026-10-18.

## This Phase Does Not Close
The python module and its roles (phase bj); hooks on non-task commands;
cross-host hook execution; any replay of missed cron ticks.

## Decisions
D-1 fixed hook environment (`ATM_TEAM`, `ATM_PHASE`, `PATH`, `HOME`, plus
the Windows pair); D-2 no sha in atm, drift is `doctor()`'s; D-3 one
daemon-side runner, the daemon register route the only hook-name
validator; D-4 `atm-cron` crate behind `CronScheduler` (start, end, list),
`cron` crate 0.17 UTC, no missed-tick replay, one in-flight run per
schedule, args in the stdin request only; D-5 phases are independent
(Rand 2026-10-18): active phases' hooks run oldest first and the
chain stops at the first reply that is not not-applicable, any roster member may register or
start; D-6 `request` is
the bare HTTP body, an action is `{command, as, request}` over any routed
command except the hook and cron registry; D-7 contract types and traits
in bk-2, codes in bk-1; D-8 in-memory active-hook snapshot, `Local`
ingress, caller from the request; D-9 mandatory stop condition (`--until`
or `--until-hook`, `cron.stop`), `atm cron end` the manual stop; D-10
hooks are an input filter on the `TaskCommands` trait (Rand, 2026-10-18),
with no nesting variable or header, and a method with no registration
passes through. Replies are four results, `handled`, `pass-through`,
`not-applicable` and `refused` (Rand 2026-10-18, `design.md` §2.2). Review round 1 (2026-10-18) also carries D-a..D-r
(`design.md` §2.2, §5, §6, §9) and Rand's malformed and panic rulings;
Rand's 2026-10-18 rulings set D-l (registration-time `--custom` JSON),
D-q (cron timeout `CRON_TIMEOUT_MS`, at most 30 s) and D-r (per-schedule
jitter).

## Governed interfaces (ADR-061)

- HTTP API: six additive `RequestEnvelope` variants, the `HookActions`
  response and the `X-ATM-Hook-Actions` header; `HTTP_API_VERSION`

  `openapi.yaml` copies and the six paths.
- Hook stdin/stdout contract: `HOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION` independent of
  `HTTP_API_VERSION` (ADR-068 D8); one key-pinning test in bk-2.
- Herdr IPC: unchanged.
acceptance_criteria:
## Success Criteria
- `atm task close` on a team with an active `task.close` hook replying `{"result": "refused", "message": "m"}` fails with `ATM_HOOK_REFUSED` `m` and the task stays `active`; `pass-through` equals an un-hooked close; `handled` with an `atm-action` list runs the listed commands in order un-hooked; any other reply is `ATM_HOOK_MALFORMED` (ANC-001, ANC-004..008).
- With several phases registered for one hook, the modules run oldest `registered_at` first under one request budget until one replies other than not-applicable; all not-applicable runs the normal command (D-5).
- The hook module receives exactly `ATM_TEAM`, `ATM_PHASE`, `PATH`, `HOME` (Windows: `SystemRoot`, `USERPROFILE`, `HOME` optional) and the registered cwd, and is killed at its deadline with `ATM_HOOK_TIMEOUT` (REQ-BK-D1, ANC-012).
- `atm hook register` refuses a module without a valid `TIMEOUT_MS` and the daemon refuses a timeout over the cap; phases are independent; `atm hook disable --phase <x>` keeps the rows inactive (ANC-010, ANC-011, D-5).
- `atm cron start` rows carry one stop condition and a fixed jitter, survive a daemon restart, tick in UTC at the next future occurrence only, never replay missed ticks, never overlap, and record `last_run_at`/`last_outcome` (ANC-017..025, REQ-BK-D4A, REQ-BK-D4B).
- `atm doctor` from the registered team lists each active module, cwd and phase with its `doctor()` reply or typed error and never fails because of it; atm stores no module sha (ANC-015, ANC-016, D-2).
- `HTTP_API_VERSION` is `1.13.0`, `hook_registration` and `cron_schedule` are additive MINOR tables with the ADR-061 D3 proof test, the six codes are in `docs/atm-error-codes.md`, and `docs/user-documents/hooks.md` documents the module contract.

## Validation
- `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `just lint`, `just test` at the stack top.
